display.reason: Associates Program Policies permit a Site to show price and availability only when Amazon serves the link carrying that data, or when the data comes from the Creators/PA API under the License; images and other Product Advertising Content may be stored or cached for no more than 24 hours. This site is a static build with no API refresh, so volatile figures (price, rating, rating count, badges, 'bought in past month') are not displayed on shop pages. They remain in the verification register as dated observations of what the listing showed on the check date.

cadence.rule: One guide per week, published Tuesday. Each guide is added to data/editorial-driven sitemap.xml and feed.xml by build_site.py; no page exists on the sitemap that the build did not write. A new guide is only promoted from the calendar after its topic question is checked against the register (no claim without a source).
cadence.measure: After Search Console has 28 days of queries (SG-02), the next four topics are chosen from arriving queries that our pages do not answer, not from instinct. Until then the calendar below is a stated plan, not a demand claim.

voice.name: Plain-spoken buying desk
rules: Second person, active voice, one idea per sentence.
Every claim names its source in the same breath, or it is not written.
No 'we tested', 'we loved', 'game-changer', 'must-have', 'best-in-class' - we have not used any of these products.
No invented scarcity, countdowns, or 'everyone is buying' lines.
Numbers beat adjectives: '34.0 cm deep' instead of 'compact'.
Where a spec is missing, the page says so in the sentence where the reader wanted it.
Headlines are questions a buyer types, not promises about outcomes.
Short paragraphs, real headings, a next step at the end of every page.
